## Circular to Licensed Corporations and Registered Institutions

## Emergency Contact Person

It  has come to our attention some licensed corporations and registered institutions may not have kept the SFC updated of their latest information regarding emergency contact person.

The SFC believes that it is important to maintain good and effective communication with its intermediaries,  especially  during  emergency  situations.    Licensed  corporations  should therefore  promptly  notify  the  SFC  if  there  have  been  changes  of  their  emergency  contact person to not only ensure its compliance with the relevant SFO provisions, but also allows the SFC to keep up to date of the emergency contacts.  For registered institutions, they are required to notify both the SFC and the Hong Kong Monetary Authority upon any changes to their emergency contacts.

Section 135(3) of the Securities and Futures Ordinance ('SFO') sets out the events for which notification by licensed persons and registered institutions is required.  Amongst others, these specific events, which are listed under Schedule 3 to the Securities and Futures (Licensing and Registration) (Information) Rules, include changes in the name, correspondence address, contact  telephone  and  facsimile  numbers  and  electronic  mail  address  of  each  emergency contact person appointed by the licensed corporations and/or registered institutions.

In order to comply with the requirement under section 135(3) of the SFO, the person shall, within 7 business days of the change, give notice in writing of such change .  Failing to comply with the requirement, without reasonable excuse, is an offence under the law.

Should  you  have  any  queries,  please  do  not  hesitate  to  contact  your  Intermediaries Relationship Manager.

Licensing Department Intermediaries and Investment Products Division Securities and Futures Commission
